source: T-13008 forward inventory (agent-spaces 26ab619396e72bcc0186708c1940a395577529c4) with the T-13018 r2 overrides; generated once by T-13039

rows.condition: A method raspd does not serve and Bun does not implement (aspc.noSuchMethod, aspc.).
A frame serde_json cannot parse: true garbage, or valid JSON that JS JSON.parse accepts but serde rejects (a lone UTF-16 surrogate escape like \ud83d, a number beyond f64 like 1e400).
rows.note: Slice 2: frames JSON.parse accepts are accepted; until then sole mode answers every unjudged frame -32700 parse_error.

rows.condition: One of the five aspc ops raspd does not serve yet (T-13018 section 3).
rows.note: Slice 3 serves or refuses each op; until then sole mode answers -32601 op_unsupported.

rows.condition: resolve/inspect context.agentId is '' or an Object.prototype member name (constructor, toString, ...).
rows.note: Empty agentId: Bun's -32603. Prototype names are slice 2 native (own-property lookup).

rows.condition: The agent profile sets [placement] launch = "participant-only".
agent-profile.toml parses but fails profile validation (here an unknown key).
A space:agent:<id> ref is resolved with no agent root.
The agent has tools/bin and an entry there breaks validateAgentTools: name not /^[a-z][a-z0-9._-]*$/, reserved name (git, bash, ...), not a regular file or in-tree symlink, or not executable.
mkdir -p of <agentRoot>/var/{state,cache,logs} or var/state/projects/<id> fails (e.g. var is a regular file, or the agent root is read-only).

$ASP_HOME/config.toml is not valid TOML (or holds a value raspd's parser forwards) and raspd needs the canonical agents root from it: compile with an explicit aspHome (prompt.rs:1396), or the daemon env without ASP_AGENTS_ROOT (mod.rs:1018, prompt.rs:1398).
Writing <aspHome>/global-lock.json fails (dir create, temp-file create/fsync, or rename), e.g. the aspHome directory itself is not writable.
The published target bundle does not validate (.asp-materialized.json fingerprint/complete/requiredPaths) right after publish_target released the bundle-scope lock.

Another holder keeps the target's bundle-scope materialization lock (<aspHome>/tmp/locks/bundle-scope-<sha256(publicScopeRoot/bundles)[:32]>.lock.lock) fresh for longer than the 600x100 ms retry window.
rows.note: T-13018 r2 section 2.3: one 60 s wait, then lock_timeout (held); an I/O failure is compiler_exception.

rows.condition: The harness version probe (claude/muse --version, codex --version or app-server --help) dies from a signal raspd did not send.
Spawning the probe command fails (override or PATH entry missing, not executable).
try_wait on the probe child returns an error.
claude harness compile while no executable claude is found from the daemon's ASP_CLAUDE_PATH, the common install paths, or PATH.
Codex: the published bundle validates (its manifest requires only codex.home and mcp.json) but codex.home/config.toml or AGENTS.md is missing or of the wrong kind.
The canonical JSON of the composed codex config (698) or a staged space's codex.config.json written earlier in the same request (875) fails to parse.
Codex: the runtime home's config.toml, copied from the published template, cannot be parsed by raspd's TOML reader when hook trust is written.
Codex compile while another holder keeps <aspHome>/codex-homes/<project>_<target>/.asp-runtime.lock.lock fresh beyond the 600x100 ms retry window.
rows.note: T-13018 r2 section 2.3: one 60 s wait, then lock_timeout (held); an I/O failure is compiler_exception.

rows.condition: Codex non-interactive (app-server) compile: the runtime home's hooks.json, copied from the published template, is not valid JSON. Interactive compiles rewrite it first.
codex compile whose selected model is outside the Codex adapter list (codex.rs ADAPTER_MODELS).
An effective codex option (model_reasoning_effort, approval_policy, sandbox_mode) is present but not a string.
Codex: a space's harness="codex" pre_tool_use [[hook]] has a script path (or space id) outside /^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$/ or with a '..' segment.
Codex: a space-hooks.json does not parse, either the staged per-space file (879) or, for an interactive compile, the runtime home's copy of the published template's space-hooks.json (1203).
Codex compile when no candidate codex binary (ASP_CODEX_PATH, common user paths, PATH) exists and passes the --version >= 0.124.0 and app-server --help probes in the daemon's own environment.
Claude: two plugin dirs of the published bundle (spaces and/or agent-local) both ship commands/<name>.md.
Compile params carry compileContext (nowIso, idSalt, toolchainManifest).
The config.toml under the caller's agentSources.aspHome (or daemon ASP_HOME) is TOML that toml_edit refuses.
taskContext.taskId differs from the sessionRef scope's task (mod.rs:668), or placement.agentRoot's basename/bundle.agentName differs from agent.id (request.rs:673).
agent-profile.toml [instructions] template names a file found nowhere on the search path.
context-template.toml is rejected by parseContextTemplate: wrong schema_version, unknown section type, bad when/wrap/max_chars, legacy [section], or TOML that does not parse.
The template declares max_chars and the resolved prompt plus reminder exceed it.
A claude continuation observation whose frozenStartRequest.placement.cwd is truthy but not a string.
compileRequest.continuation is missing hrc or has a mistyped hrc/broker/source field.
compileRequest.correlation has a non-string id field (e.g. requestId 42).
The space dependency graph has a cycle (e.g. two @dev spaces whose deps.spaces name each other).
$aspHome/default-targets.toml parses and passes the schema but fails the targets semantic checks (e.g. a target sets both priming and priming_append), and the project has an asp-targets.toml.
$aspHome/default-targets.toml exists but cannot be read (mode 000, a directory), and the project has an asp-targets.toml.
A space depends across a forbidden edge: registry->agent, registry->project, agent->project or project->agent.
compile: params.aspHome is ''. resolve/inspect: the daemon's own ASP_HOME env is set but empty.
rows.note: compile: Bun's success writes under the daemon cwd (a defect); refused invalid_params. resolve/inspect: Bun's configured_source_unavailable.

rows.condition: A path canonical_directory must canonicalize is '': agentSources.aspHome/agentsRoot '', or project mode root with projectRoot ''.
A stat/access/open fails with an errno raspd has no Bun message for (anything but ENOENT/ENOTDIR/EACCES/EISDIR), e.g. ENAMETOOLONG, ELOOP, EOPNOTSUPP (a unix socket opened as a file).
rows.note: Bun's failure per site: stat (default), project-targets search, source read, priming file.

rows.condition: $aspHome/global-lock.json exists but is not JSON or not lock-shaped (spaces/targets not objects, a space entry missing string id/commit/integrity); mod.rs:1424 is the same check on the re-read inside the lock-file lock.
rows.note: T-13018 r2 section 2.2: a global-lock.json that fails the lock schema refuses before it is merged or rewritten, in both modes.

rows.condition: The lock-file lock for <aspHome>/global-lock.json cannot be taken: held by another process past the 600x100ms retry budget, or its file/dir cannot be created (e.g. <aspHome>/tmp/locks is a file).
rows.note: T-13018 r2 section 2.3: one 60 s wait, then lock_timeout (held); an I/O failure is compiler_exception.

rows.condition: $aspHome/global-lock.json exists but reading it fails with anything other than ENOENT (mode 000, a directory).
A [[hook]] in a space's hooks/hooks.toml has a non-string event or script, or a tools array with a non-string element.
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused, not native (a JavaScript coercion nothing has sent).

rows.condition: hrcPolicy carries an unknown key or a mistyped value (e.g. resourceLimits.startupTimeoutMs a string).
Inspect of an agent whose context template has two sections with the same zone and name (two [[prompt]] name = "note").
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused compiler_exception, not native.

rows.condition: Inspect whose effective harness is agent-harness or muse, including an agent with no declared harness and no provisionDirectives.harness (defaults to agent-harness).
rows.note: Lance 2026-11-09: agent-harness and muse are refused until needed.

rows.condition: The declaration's effectiveHarness is not a known harness id.
The compiled plan carries resolvedBundle.lockHash or artifacts.lockHash.
Inspect of an agent root with SOUL.md but no agent-profile.toml.
A regular file inside a composed agent- or project-local space cannot be read (e.g. mode 000).
Iterating an already-opened directory inside an agent/project space yields an I/O error for an entry.
DirEntry::file_type() fails, or stat of a file fails right after it was read successfully.
Params fail Bun's aspc params validator (unknown key, wrong literal/enum, wrong type) for compile, inspect or any of the three reads.
placement.correlation.sessionRef.laneRef (inspect: preparationCorrelation.sessionRef.laneRef) normalizes to lane:<id> where <id> is not a valid token.
rows.note: Bun's codes: inspect throws (-32603 internal_error), which raspd reproduces.

rows.condition: emit() is reached with a Codex launch, or emit_codex() with a Claude launch.
materialization carries non-empty attachments, an unknown key, or a taskContext shape raspd does not judge.
Any filesystem error while staging or composing (e.g. a dangling symlink in agent-local commands/, which is followed; or an unlistable directory inside a space component dir).
A composed space's mcp/mcp.json is valid JSON but has no object mcpServers (e.g. {"servers":{}}).
The selected model value is not a string.
raspd's blocking native handler panicked (a raspd defect); raspd relays the request to Bun.
rows.note: A panic answers -32603 and logs a raspd defect, never a relay, in both modes.

rows.condition: A composed space declares [path].exclude and <aspHome>/codex-homes/<project>_<agent>/zdotdir cannot be created (e.g. a regular file sits at that path).
A composed space declares [path].exclude and the existing zdotdir/farm cannot be removed with remove_dir_all: it is a regular file, or holds an entry its owner cannot unlink.
rows.note: Native rm_rf semantics (a file farm is unlinked); a farm rm -rf cannot remove refuses (write-time).

rows.condition: codex compile whose hrcPolicy.permissionPolicy is a record with no string mode.
A space's permissions.toml has a non-string element in any of the string arrays (read/write paths, exec commands/patterns, network hosts, deny.*).
No project id derivable from scope: the sessionRef scopeRef has no project segment (or there is no sessionRef) and placement.projectRoot is absent.
compileRequest.placement has a key, type or path raspd does not judge (e.g. placement.correlation.requestId, non-absolute agentRoot, missing bundle).
The project target sets both priming and priming_append.
The profile sets priming_file to a path under the agent root that cannot be read (missing, unreadable).
identity.avatar is a URL raspd cannot judge without a WHATWG parser (upper-case scheme HTTPS://, non-ASCII host, ports, IP hosts ...).
agent-profile.toml is not valid TOML (toml_edit or iarna rejects it).

agent-profile.toml exists but read_to_string fails, e.g. it contains a non-UTF-8 byte (Latin-1 0xE9 in a comment). inspect.rs:374 is only reachable by a race after prompt.rs:1460 has read the same file.
A space:project:<id> ref is composed and the compile placement carries no projectRoot.
A project's asp-targets.toml passes the schema but fails a semantic check (here priming and priming_append on one target).
Inspect, and a template section fails to resolve (e.g. exec section exits 1; also failed file/slot/service-probe sections).
stat and access(R_OK) succeed but realpath(3) fails: here a short path through two symlinks to a directory whose real path exceeds PATH_MAX (ENAMETOOLONG).
The selected reasoningEffort value is not a string.
The selected harness is neither claude/claude-hrcpty nor codex/codex-hrcpty (agent-harness, muse).
rows.note: Lance 2026-11-09: agent-harness and muse are refused until needed.

rows.condition: A composed space ref (profile spaces.base/modes, target compose or a space deps entry) has a selector other than none/@dev: git:<sha>, HEAD, a semver or a dist-tag.
rows.note: Only the compile's own target's pin refuses; another target's pin in the shared global lock does not (snapshot_missing is native).

rows.condition: release.json in the serving release root cannot be read or is not JSON at compile time.
release.json assets.claude-statusline.path resolves outside the release root.
release.json has no assets.claude-statusline {path, sha256} strings (mod.rs:1322); stage.rs:1058 is publish_claude_target receiving no statusline.
The selected broker driver (codex-app-server, claude-code-tmux, claude-code-hrcpty) has no entry in release.json workerBindings.
release.json workerBindings is missing or not a record, a binding is not a string, its executable has no string launcher, or the launcher path does not resolve.
A file section with required = true points at a file that does not exist or is empty.
A required file section's path exists but cannot be read (e.g. it is a directory; also EACCES).
A required file section's ref cannot be resolved: escapes its root (agent-root:///../X), empty or multi-line ref, absolute path after a scheme, or project-root:/// without a project.
placement.correlation.sessionRef.scopeRef (inspect: preparationCorrelation.sessionRef.scopeRef) is not a canonical ScopeRef, e.g. a shorthand handle agent@project:task.
rows.note: T-13018 r2: the scope contract makes caller input strict; the legacy shorthand is invalid_params.

rows.condition: A service-probe endpoint raspd's simplified parser will not judge: no scheme (localhost:8080), other scheme (redis://), IPv6 literal, out-of-range port, host with _ or other non [A-Za-z0-9.-] characters, userinfo or %-escapes.
Claude: two plugin dirs of the published bundle both ship skills/<name>/SKILL.md (e.g. a space and the agent-local plugin).
A slot section's source path has a segment named like an Object.prototype member (e.g. source = "instructions.constructor").
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused, not native (a JavaScript coercion nothing has sent).

rows.condition: $aspHome/global-lock.json holds a registry (git-pinned) space entry, of any target, whose snapshots/<integrity> dir is absent.
rows.note: T-13018 r2: a missing snapshot belongs to another target's pin (this target's pins refuse registry_space first), which does not refuse this compile; the check is deleted.

rows.condition: SOUL.md exists under the agent root but cannot be read (a directory, mode 000).
rows.note: Slice 2 makes the lossy read native; a SOUL.md that cannot be read refuses compiler_exception (Bun returns an empty prompt, a defect raspd does not copy).

rows.condition: agent-profile.toml or a project's asp-targets.toml exists but cannot be read (here mode 000, EACCES).
A deps.spaces entry of a space manifest is not a string.
A composed space's space.toml declares [harness] supports without 'agent-harness' (e.g. ["claude"] or ["codex"]).
A composed ref's space id matches the kebab-case pattern but is longer than 64 characters (the profile and targets patterns carry no length bound).
A composed space.toml parses but fails space.schema.json, or uses [plugin] author / homepage / repository (email/uri formats raspd does not judge).
rows.note: Part 1 (plugin author/homepage/repository) is slice 2 native; part 2 refuses.

rows.condition: A composed space's space.toml is not valid TOML.
A composed space's space.toml cannot be read: the space does not exist (ENOENT), the file is mode 000 (EACCES), or the path is a directory.
A composed ref is space:path:<path>@<selector> (accepted by the profile, targets and space schemas).
rows.note: T-13018 r2: compiler_exception, no third new code.

rows.condition: A ref reaching the closure lacks the space:/spaces: prefix or has an id/selector outside the grammar.
Claude compile: the release's claude-statusline asset file named in release.json cannot be read.
Claude compile: the release's claude-statusline asset bytes do not hash to the sha256 recorded in release.json.
Agent-local commands/ (copied with followSymlinks) holds a symlink that resolves to an ancestor directory (e.g. commands/loop -> .).
A project's asp-targets.toml fails targets.schema.json (unknown top-level key, schema != 2, ...).
A project's asp-targets.toml is not valid TOML.

The project asp-targets.toml exists but read_to_string fails, e.g. a non-UTF-8 byte (Latin-1 0xE9 in a comment). On compile the strict read at compile/mod.rs:1094 forwards source_read_unavailable first.
Interpolated text (template content, wrap, file content, priming) contains {{name}} where name is an Object.prototype member ({{constructor}}, {{toString}} ...).
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused, not native (a JavaScript coercion nothing has sent).

rows.condition: The winning context-template.toml exists but read_to_string fails, e.g. a non-UTF-8 byte (Latin-1 0xE9 in a comment).
A TOML file holds an integer outside +/-(2^53-1) (e.g. space.toml [codex.config] big_limit = 9007199254740993, or a profile field).
A TOML file starts with a UTF-8 BOM (U+FEFF).
A TOML file raspd parses holds a date/time value (e.g. space.toml [codex.config] rollout_after = 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, or a date in agent-profile.toml).
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused, not native.

rows.condition: The codex config.toml raspd renders contains an array mixing types, e.g. a space mcp/mcp.json server with args ["server.js", "--port", 8080]; codex compile.
A TOML file holds inf, -inf or nan (e.g. space.toml [codex.config] temperature = inf, or priming = nan).
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused, not native.

rows.condition: A TOML table has a key named __proto__ (e.g. space.toml [codex.config] __proto__ = "x", or [provisioning] __proto__).
rows.note: T-13018 r2: refused, not native.

rows.condition: The TOML text contains four consecutive quotes ("""" or '''') anywhere, e.g. a multi-line string ending in a quote (priming = """...reply "done"""").
rows.note: A run inside a comment or another string kind parses natively in Bun (slice 2).

rows.condition: The codex config.toml value holds a null inside an inline table (e.g. mcp.json args [[{"k": null}]]); sites 44 and 266 are unreachable (the config is always a table, complex entries are always arrays/tables).
A space's hooks/hooks.toml or permissions.toml is not valid TOML.
A space's hooks/hooks.toml or permissions.toml exists but read_to_string fails: no read permission, or bytes that are not UTF-8.
A section max_chars truncation cut lands between the two UTF-16 halves of a non-BMP character (emoji).
The selected model is not in the harness catalog (claude + gpt-5.5, claude + claude-opus-4-1).
The selected modelProvider is not the harness's provider (claude + openai).
